snippet.title: BRAINSHELL - Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
Play the Demo Now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4414020?utm_source=youtube

Did you ever wonder what it would be like to become an Intercontinental Ballistic Missile? BRAINSHELL is a psychological horror experience focusing on immersion, storytelling and audiovisual torment.
